up: Retrieve the distinct compound identifiers from document CHEMBL5728495. The query should return the ChEMBL identifier (chembl_id) of each compound reported in the given document. All results must be filtered by the specified document identifier (doc_id = CHEMBL5728495). The compound identifiers should be presented as a list of distinct CHEMBL compound identifiers without additional filtering or transformation.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT cs.chembl_id
FROM docs d
JOIN activities a ON d.doc_id = a.doc_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728495';

The result must be filtered by the specified document identifier (docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728495') and must include only distinct compound identifiers. No additional filtering, limits, or transformations are required.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name AS chembl_id
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728495'
